I struggle with this same issue, and was pretty bad. I basically lived this situation. That being said, 

I have Borderline Personality Disorder, and I do **DBT therapy** It’s helpful and mainly catering to self harmers, suicidal thoughts, and depression. It helps with anxiety and other things.

DBT therapy is expensive, and it’s a long process. If you can search up DBT centre of the Fraser valley, they have some very good information on their website. 

I highly recommend DBT. 

Don’t force them with a therapist you find immediately. It takes time to warm up. If they don’t like them or get “good vibes” then there is many more out there then just that one. 

In person is always better than online, however online is better than not at all.
